tei:div.tei:p: 1$0000250rta lha'i mnga' gsol ni/1$0000300 na mo h+ya grī wa ya/

rta lha'i mnga' gsol byed na/ bsang gi dus sam gsol ka'i dus/ sha khrag ma 'dres pa'i gtor ma rin po che'i dbyibs can bcas nas phye mar shug dud btang la/ a kā ro sa byin gyis brlabs nas rnga rol dbyangs dang bcas pas 'di skad do// hūm̐/ sum rtsen lcang lo can dang dgung sngon dbus// rang bzhin gar bzhugs gnas mchog dam pa nas// rdo rje khro bo ār+ya re man+ta// nor lha gnod sbyin bye ba 'bum dang bcas// rlung ltar myur ba'i shugs kyis 'dir gshegs la// dngos 'byor yid spru+ul mnga' gsol mchod pa bzhes// zhim mngar spos sprin dkar gsum mngar gsum dang*// dar zab 'bru sman mchod pas mnga' gsol lo// 'gro ba rkang 'khyams sdug bsngal skyob mdzad pa// 'gro ba'i mgon gyur mgon po rta mang zhes// 'phags mchog sar gnas sems dpa' re man+ta// bdag gi rta yi mgon du mnga' gsol lo// lha rnams yongs kyi so pa spyan rnon po// shar phyogs skyong ba'i mgon po dpal rab 'chang*// bdag gi rta drel rngog chags thams cad kun// srung zhing skyob pa'i so par mnga' gsol lo// rta lha'i rgyal po ār+ya re man+ta// rngog chags thams cad 'phel zhing rgyas par mdzad// nor lha chen po 'phags pa re man+ta// rnal 'byor bdag gi lam lhar mnga' gsol lo// lha dmag bye ba 'bum gyi lam mkhan te// nyi ma'i sras po rlung rta bdun gyi bdag /lam lha chen po gzhon nu re man+ta// rnal 'byor bdag gi lam lhar mnga' gsol lo// rab khros gnod sbyin bya gcan sprul pa 'gyed// rngog chags la gnod dgra bgegs brlag mdzad pa'i// chos skyong srung ma khro bo re man+ta// bdag gi rta yi srung mar mnga' gsol lo// srid gsum dbang sgyur gnod sbyin gang ba bzang*// rta bdag chen po dpal dang 'byor pa'i bdag /rta rnams srung zhing skyob par dam bcas pa// bdag gi rta yi srung mar mnga' gsol lo// byang chub sems dpa' gser 'dra seng ge zhon// rdo rje rnam thos sras po nor gyi bdag

/rta nor rngog chags thams cad 'phel mdzad pa// bdag gi rta lha'i mchog tu mnga' gsol lo// gtsug lag khang dang dkyil 'khor srung ma che// rnal 'byor dgra bla dug gsum nad kyi sman// dgra bgegs 'dul mdzad ma hā kā la che// rta 'dre gnod byed 'dul bar mnga' gsol lo// rta bdag gnod sbyin chen po ku be ra// rang 'dra sprul pa'i 'khor tshogs 'bum dang bcas// rngog chags srung zhing mel tshe mdzad pa'i lha// bdag gi rta yi rdzi bor mnga' gsol lo// sprul pa'i gnod sbyin ār+ya re man+ta// lnga brgya dang bcas nor lha bye ba 'bum// bdag gi rta drel rngog chags 'phel ba'i phyir// rta dang nor gyi lha ru mnga' gsol lo/ /gsol lo// mchod do// rta lha chen po la gsol lo// mchod do// rdo rje re man+ta la gsol lo// mchod do// dpal rab 'chang ba'i mgon po la gsol lo// mchod do// ār+ya re man+ta la gsol lo// mchod do// nyi ma'i sras po la gsol lo// mchod do/ khro bo chen po re man+ta la gsol lo// mchod do// rang 'dra'i 'khor tshogs lnga brgya la gsol lo// mchod do// dpal 'byor gang ba bzang po la gsol lo// mchod do// rdo rje rnam thos sras po la gsol lo// mchod do// rta lha mgon po nag po la gsol lo// mchod do// rta bdag ku be ra la gsol lo// mchod do// nor bdag bye ba 'bum dang bcas pa la gsol lo mchod do// gsol zhing mchod pa la brten nas/ bdag gi rta drel rngog chags thams cad 'phel zhing rgyas la/ tshe srog brtan pa'i phrin las mdzod cig /rta nad thams cad rab tu zhi ba dang*/ rta 'dre rtil sri thams cad rdul du brlag par mdzod cig / ces gtor ma bsang nang du phul lo/// /
